title: Critical analysis, characterization, and treatment of microplastics in the peripheral rivers of Dhaka city: Buriganga and Turag
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1810-1833
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00118H, Paper
Open Access

Foysal Mahmud, Hridoy Roy, Md. Mahmud Kamal Bhuiyan, Md. Shahinoor Islam
This research identifies matrix and season-influenced microplastic pollution in the rivers of Dhaka in a systematic way, and an effective electrocoagulation process delivers actionable solutions for cleaner urban waterways.
